top_stories.title: Vizag Collector prepares for Naidu’s visit - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **District Collector M. Abhishikth Kishore** directed officials to prepare for the visit of **Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu** to Visakhapatnam on June 5 and 8.  **Naidu** will attend a National Conference on Seafood Exports on June 5, participate in a review meeting on the Visakhapatnam Economic Region (VER) on June 6, and visit the Centre of Excellence for Energy Transition (CoEET) and the APIs Technologies semiconductor unit on June 8. **Kishore** also instructed officials to ensure smooth coordination among departments, security arrangements, and delegate pass issuance.

top_stories.title: Petroleum dealers threaten to go on strike if action is not taken on those who damaged Thoothukudi fuel outlet - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Petroleum dealers** in Tamil Nadu have threatened to strike if their demands for increased security and action against attackers are not met. **K.P. Murali**, president of the **Tamil Nadu Petroleum Dealers’ Association**, stated that they want the **Goondas Act** invoked against perpetrators, a crackdown on drugs, and protection measures for employees. The dealers are demanding safety assurances after an attack on an Indian Oil Corporation Ltd. pump in Thoothukudi left one employee injured.  The incident highlights the challenges faced by retail outlets, including security concerns and unruly customer behavior.

top_stories.title: Kochi-Bahrain AI Express flight cancelled amid Kuwait airspace closure - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Air India Express** cancelled its flight from Kochi to Bahrain on Wednesday due to **Kuwait** closing its airspace following an attack at the international airport. The airline suspended flights to Kuwait through June 6, 2026, and is assisting impacted passengers with notifications and booking adjustments. Passengers are advised to check their flight status on airindiaexpress.com and update their contact information.

top_stories.title: Indian national Tarsem Singh charged in crash that killed pregnant teen, victim’s mother calls for ICE deportation: 'They can send him wherever' - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Ashlee Holmes**, a 17-year-old pregnant teenager, died in a car crash in Ohio after being ejected from a vehicle driven by **Tarsem Singh**, an Indian national who faces multiple felony charges.  Singh was driving illegally and led police on a high-speed chase before losing control of his Range Rover, causing the fatal crash. **Annette Holmes**, Ashlee's mother, has demanded that Singh be deported, stating she does not want him in the United States. The Department of Homeland Security (DHS) confirmed Singh entered the country illegally in 2017 and is currently being held on a $1 million bond.  Singh's trial is scheduled for August.

top_stories.title: U.S. proposes 12.5% tariff on India and other countries, Indian govt says it ‘remains engaged’ with U.S. - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: The U.S. government has proposed a 12.5% tariff on imports from 54 countries, including India, due to concerns about the enforcement of prohibitions against forced labor in their import practices. **India** maintains its engagement with the U.S. regarding this matter and the ongoing negotiations for an Interim Agreement on trade. The USTR argues that these tariffs are necessary to address a "dynamic" where American workers face unfair competition from countries not adequately addressing forced labor issues.  The proposed tariffs, part of Section 301 investigations, could impact industries like textiles and apparel.

top_stories.title: CREDAI discusses with CM Vijay issues concerning real estate sector in Tamil Nadu - The Hindu
top_stories.sentiment_target: Tamil Nadu's Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay
top_stories.rephrased_article: **CREDAI**, the Confederation of Real Estate Developers Associations of India, met with **Tamil Nadu's Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay** to discuss issues affecting the state's real estate sector. The delegation highlighted concerns regarding delays in approvals and requested a streamlined single-window system for faster project execution. They also raised concerns about the Ramsar designation on Pallikaranai Marsh, impacting landowners and hindering access to financial services. **CREDAI** proposed scrapping the designation or establishing a committee to complete the notification process within 30 days.  They further advocated for expanding the scope of self-certification and automatic building approval systems under the single-window mechanism.

top_stories.title: Info panel rejects claim that CCTV footage in police station got auto-deleted - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: The **Tamil Nadu Information Commission** has rejected the claim that CCTV footage from a Tiruvallur police station was auto-deleted. The commission criticized the **Tiruvallur Town police** for failing to provide requested footage and directed a supervisory officer to investigate the Public Information Officer's actions, potentially leading to disciplinary action.  The case stemmed from a petitioner alleging his mobile phone was taken and data erased by police without consent.

top_stories.title: Amid broken ties, Rahul, Kharge hail Karunanidhi on his birth anniversary - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Congress** president Mallikarjun Kharge and **Rahul Gandhi** paid tributes to former Tamil Nadu Chief Minister **Muthuvel Karunanidhi**, fondly known as "Kalaignar," on his birthday.  Kharge praised **Karunanidhi's** lifelong commitment to social justice and democratic values, while Gandhi highlighted his dedication to the dignity of the Tamil people. The tributes are seen as an attempt to mend strained ties between the Congress and the DMK following the party's alliance with actor-turned politician Vijay's Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK).

top_stories.title: Calcutta High Court to hear Abhishek’s plea seeking protection - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Abhishek Banerjee**, general secretary of the **Trinamool Congress**, was granted permission by the Calcutta High Court to file a petition seeking protection against coercive action from the West Bengal CID. The court is expected to hear the matter later this week.  The legal team representing Mr. Banerjee argued that he had no connection to the case, while Enforcement Directorate officials served him with a notice for questioning in the primary teacher recruitment scam. Two Trinamool MLAs filed a complaint alleging forged signatures on a letter declaring **Sobhandeb Chattopadhyay** as the party's choice for Leader of Opposition (LoP), leading to an FIR and summons against Mr. Banerjee. The controversy has caused a split within the party, with at least 58 MLAs forming a new opposition group.

top_stories.title: This Is How Trump Finally Signed the AI Executive Order | WIRED
top_stories.rephrased_article: **President Donald Trump** signed a revised executive order on AI, granting the federal government 30 days of access to advanced models before public release. The move, which reflects growing concerns about cyberattacks and was supported by industry leaders like **Anthropic** and **OpenAI**, comes after initial resistance from former AI czar David Sacks.  The order establishes a voluntary process for identifying and addressing potential vulnerabilities in these powerful systems.
